sentences.text:
This is second bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.411/2020 dated : not mentioned registered at P.S - Kanadiya District - Indore (M.P.)
for offences punishable under Section(s) 420, 467, 468 of IPC only on the ground that the matter has been amicably settled with the complainant and the complainant has no objection to grant bail to the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Lakhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: 2 . As per the prosecution case, while checking the plot no.77 Mitra Bandhu Nagar, Indore from the registrar's office on the complaint by Sanjay Singh, it was found that there was a sale deed of Rs.75000/- of that plot between the buyer Sanjay Singh father Vijay Singh and Deepak Verma father Amar Singh on 31.09.2000 but the seller Sumit Singh Thakur (applicant) sold the same plot to Kamlabai, Gopal Rathore and Sanjay Rathore on 30.04.2012 at Rs.6,97,000/-.

sentences.text:
This is second application filed under section 483 of BNSS in crime no.884/2023 under section 420,
467, 468, 471 of IPC registered at police station Barwani.
sentences._hearing_file: Lakhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024.json

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the FSL report has been filed and as per the FSL report, the signature of the applicant is not matching on the documents which are alleged to be forged.
Learned counsel for the respondent/state opposed the prayer and submits that as per the allegation,
the applicant has submitted the application for loan for business and house and alongwith the said application, various documents, no objection, mutation receipt etc of Panchayat were filed which have been found to be forged.
sentences._hearing_file: Lakhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024.json

sentences.text: He further submits that the statement of sales manager of the finance company has been recorded and he has supported the prosecution case.
sentences._hearing_file: Lakhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024.json

sentences.text: NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:26752 2 MCRC-29110-2024
sentences._hearing_file: Lakhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024.json

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the testimony of PW No.1 Vasim Khan who is working as Sales Manager in the company has clearly stated that the loan papers were submitted by the applicant and the documents alongwith said application has been found to be forged.
sentences._hearing_file: Lakhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024.json

sentences.text: In view of the testimony of PW No.1 Vasim Khan, the bail cannot be granted.
sentences._hearing_file: Lakhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024.json

2 . As per the prosecution case, while checking the plot no.77 Mitra Bandhu Nagar, Indore from the registrar's office on the complaint by Sanjay Singh, it was found that there was a sale deed of Rs.75000/- of that plot between the buyer Sanjay Singh father Vijay Singh and Deepak Verma father Amar Singh on 31.09.2000 but the seller Sumit Singh Thakur (applicant) sold the same plot to Kamlabai, Gopal Rathore and Sanjay Rathore on 30.04.2012 at Rs.6,97,000/-.

3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the similarly placed co-accused person Sumit Singh has been granted bail vide order dated 12/7/2023 passed in M.Cr.C No.29457/2023.

opennyai_summary.21_July_2023__decision:
6. It is directed that applicant Lakhan shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.

If the applicant shows symptoms of COVID-19, the doctor shall forthwith direct him to be produced before the appropriate hospital designated for the detection and treatment of COVID-19 patients.

The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.
